P.text: GrowthHYBR.deposit() allows any address to deposit tokens on behalf of any recipient without access control, and each deposit appends to userLocks[recipient] with no minimum amount requirement.
P.evidence_quote: The `GrowthHYBR.deposit()` function allows any address to deposit tokens on behalf of any recipient, creating an unbounded array of lock entries in `userLocks[recipient]`.

I.text: Token transfers should not be blockable by unbounded per-recipient lock array growth; cleanup during transfers should remain within Hyperliquid's 30M gas block limit.
I.evidence_quote: The DoS occurs during token transfers when `_beforeTokenTransfer()` calls `_cleanExpired()` to remove expired locks

V.text: An attacker can make thousands of 1-wei deposits for a victim, causing _cleanExpired() during transfers to consume 30-40M gas, exceeding Hyperliquid's 30M gas slow block limit and reverting all transfer attempts, freezing the victim's tokens.
V.evidence_quote: With 4,000+ locks, this cleanup consumes 30-40M gas (reading 4,000 slots + array compaction + storage deletions), exceeding Hyperliquid's 30M gas slow block limit
